cues: Fruits such as orange, grape and litchi are non-climacteric: they have no burst and will not ripen properly once picked.
Ethylene also makes leaves and flowers age and fall, curls tomato leaves downward in waterlogged soil, which is epinasty, and makes pineapples flower.
text: Fruits such as orange, grape and litchi are non-climacteric: they have no burst and will not ripen properly once picked. Ethylene also makes leaves and flowers age and fall, curls tomato leaves downward in waterlogged soil, which is epinasty, and makes pineapples flower. Farmers spray it as ethephon.
